recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Further edits for FHIR-31807 would be redundant and risk duplicating guidance that is already maintained on both the resource scope page and the Medication Definition module page.
issue_request: FHIR-31807 was a Published BRR change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification for R5, asking why ManufacturedItemDefinition exists separately when it seemed to add little beyond Medication. The accepted resolution was to explain the relationship to Medication and cross-refer between Pharmacy/Medication resources and the Medication Definition resources.
initial_application: Jira records the change as applied on 2022-02-02. Git history shows 777737bbd187f07ac632a3fbbe99ed1c04052e75 added the prescribing/physical-item explanation to source/manufactureditemdefinition/manufactureditemdefinition-introduction.xml, and ca41714f0e0cf008fd1159844eca56116a6ec2ae kept that explanation while making the Medication Definition module link more prominent.
additional_context: ManufacturedItemDefinition is active in source/fhir.ini and its current scope page points to the Medication Definition module. The module page explains that Medication is the prescribing resource, while MedicinalProductDefinition and related Medication Definition resources provide the detailed product facts that sit behind medication codes and support prescribing, regulatory, manufacturing, catalog, and adverse-event use. BRR Confluence minutes from October 2021 corroborate that the work group discussed this exact Medication/MPD/ManufacturedItem distinction and called for clarifying documentation.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source already contains the requested ManufacturedItemDefinition explanation, the prescribing/Medication cross-reference through the Medication Definition module, and active build configuration for the resource.

related_jiras.note: Requested clearer guidance and a more prominent Medication Definition module pointer, which was applied in the same source area and history trail.
Broader resource-boundary challenge for Medication Definition resources; it supports the context but is represented separately on the combined branch.
